description: This PHP class defines the EntryCollectionLookupSettingPair, which encapsulates a collection of LDAP entries and associated lookup settings. It includes properties for a collection interface and a lookup setting object, along with constructor and getter methods.

classes.name: EntryCollectionLookupSettingPair
classes.description: A data transfer object that holds an LDAP collection and its corresponding lookup setting.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the object with a collection and a lookup setting.

methods.name: getLookupSetting
methods.description: Returns the LDAP user lookup setting.
